overview: A pair of pop-oriented songwriters -- melodist/singer Bobby and tone-deaf lyricist Lionel -- try to eke out a living in the Los Angeles music scene. They live (along with Bobby's younger sister Jennifer) in an antique shop, and Bobby works on the side as a recording engineer until he and Lionel get their big break.
title: Getting Together

overview: In a near-future Britain, the far-right government has declared a state of emergency and suspended elections. The Queen has fled in protest, while the defence of the state is in the hands of the Guardians, a paramilitary force with absolute power and a ruthless determination to stamp out resistance.
title: The Guardians

overview: Julie Andrews presents an hour of variety.
title: The Julie Andrews Hour

overview: James O'Hara of the United States Treasury works in several branches to stop illegal activities such as smuggling contraband, tax evasion, and the like.
title: O'Hara, U.S. Treasury

overview: Dan Madigan is a veteran police officer in New York, now dedicated to investigating cases in Europe. He is incorruptible and organized crime is the target.
title: Madigan

overview: Antoine de Maximy goes on his own to different countries around the world and tries to get invited to spend the night at local people's homes to learn more about their way of life and the customs of the place.
title: J'Irai Dormir Chez Vous

overview: Asphalt Cowboys - Ladies on Tour focuses on four women who are very familiar with large vehicles such as trucks, heavy transporters or trailers. Moni, Christina, Anne and Janet are on the road in Germany and Europe and make sure that the goods they are transporting find their way to the customers. It doesn't matter that they don't conform to the stereotype of a truck driver, because everyone is the same behind the wheel. The four ladies face their challenges with a mixture of ambition, zest for action and stamina - every day anew.
title: Asphalt-Cowboys - Ladies on Tour

overview: From his kitchen, Antoine de Maximy goes behind the scenes of his travels. Between anecdotes and filming secrets, Antoine will tell the highlights.
title: J'irai dormir chez vous L'intégrale

overview: Sons and Daughters began in 1982 and initially followed the lives of the Hamilton and Palmer families. 1983 saw the introduction of The Morrell family into the series.
title: Sons and Daughters

overview: Bruce, Mark and Amelia meet car enthusiasts sharing their passion of cars from old to new, and everything in between.
title: The Car Club

overview: Comedy about the four motherless Wheeler children and their lovable but cantankerous father Zack. With Zack avoiding work, Truckie led the clan, with Doobie, Boo, and T.J.
title: The Texas Wheelers

overview: Life in the neurological wing of Lowell Memorial Hospital as seen through the eyes of Jake Goodwin, the chief neurosurgeon.
title: Doctors' Hospital

overview: The lives and loves of residents of a seedy Baltimore hotel, adapted from an off-Broadway play The Hot l Baltimore by Lanford Wilson.
title: Hot l Baltimore

overview: An omnibus work composed of six episodes depicting the horrors found in everyday life. When an ordinary daily life turns into horror, it becomes eerie.
title: Midnight Horror: Six Nights

overview: Chef Alexander Belkovich and his wife Olga will teach you how to cook delicious and simple dishes with great love and for the whole family.
title: Кухня по любви

overview: Intervention is an American television reality show dealing with the struggles faced by many different kinds of addicts. Each episode follows one or two participants, each of whom has a substance dependence or other mentally and/or physically damaging problem. The subjects believe they are being filmed for a documentary on their problem, but their situations are actually being documented in anticipation of an intervention by family and/or friends. During the intervention, each participant is given an ultimatum: go into rehabilitation immediately, or risk losing contact, income, or other privileges from the loved ones who instigated the intervention. Often, other tactics are used to persuade the addicted person into treatment, which vary depending on the situation; some of these include threats to invoke outstanding arrest warrants, applying for custody of the addict's children, foreclosing on the addict's property, and break-up of marriages or other relationships. The producers usually follow up months later to monitor the addicted person's progress and film it for "follow-up" episodes of the series or for shorter "web updates" available on the show's website.
title: Intervention

overview: Teenage game player Lu Lu inadvertently enters a game, becoming the villain Yin Er San. She then has to fully upgrade to complete the task of overcoming the demons while she explores the male protagonist's romantic feelings.
title: This Young Hero Is a Little Cold

overview: Ben Fogle travels to a trio of locations around the world to explores de-industrialisation and to uncover their stories.
title: Lost Worlds with Ben Fogle

overview: A documentary project with a rejuvenating effect. Every year in Russia more and more people prove their purpose, that at 60 everything is just beginning. They are happy to break the stereotypes about old age that have taken root in society and enjoy every day. The heroes of "Deadline" change their lifestyle without fear, find new vocations in the modeling business, act in films, become content makers, build new relationships and live so brightly and actively that even those who are commonly called "young" will envy them. After all, age is not an obstacle to the realization of a dream.
title: Дедлайн

overview: Makenna Held bought Julia Child's home in France and turned it into a recipe-free cooking school. Now, she and her team welcome students into this iconic kitchen where enthusiasts learn to step out of their comfort zone and tap into their intuition.
title: La Pitchoune: Cooking in France

overview: Hosted by Brihony Dawson and filmed in Buenos Aires, Argentina, The Challenge Australia will see an algorithm randomly pair challengers to compete in gruelling physical contests, test strategies, survive eliminations, cutthroat alliances and steamy hook-ups to win daily challenges and eliminate their opponents. The final male and female challengers will be declared Challenge champions by the end of the season, winning $100,000 each in prize money and their entry into the first ever The Challenge: Global Championship, where they will represent Australia in hopes to be the first ever Challenge World Champion. With old rivalries, new alliances, messy exes, and fractured friendships to navigate, who has what it takes to go down in reality television history, as Australia's first Challenge Champion?
title: The Challenge Australia

overview: The producers of Police Story investigate the medical realm, displaying strong diagnostics.
title: Medical Story

overview: John Lurie knows absolutely nothing about fishing, but that doesn't stop him from undertaking the adventure of a lifetime on Fishing with John. Traveling with his special guests to the most exotic and dangerous places on earth, John Lurie battles sharks with Jim Jarmusch off the tip of Long Island, goes ice fishing with Willem Dafoe at Maine's northernmost point, braves the Costa Rican jungle with Matt Dillon, takes Tom Waits to Jamaica, and searches for the elusive giant squid with Dennis Hopper in Thailand.
title: Fishing with John

overview: Seven Wonders centers on Dr. Nate Grady, a brilliant botanist-adventurer who teams up with the slippery international fixer Sloane Seydoux on a breathless race to solve an ancient mystery tied to the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World.
title: Seven Wonders

overview: Roisaithong is an orphan girl who was adopted by Rungrorng's father, and upon his father's death was looked after by him. When Roisaithong discovered that Rungrorng viewed her in a romantic way and not as a sister, she begins to attempt to run away. However... this task seems to be quite difficult since Rungrorng is always around her and watching her. This drama is about a young girl's journey of escaping her benefactor who is sexually perverted and has caused her a lot of trauma. Will Roisaithong be able to change her life? Adapted from the novel of the same name by author Khun Kritsana Asokesin (กฤษณา อโศกสิน).
title: The Root

overview: A young teenager, Tyar starts to experience supernatural apparitions. Initially treating the strange events as a means to develop their online 'ghost hunting' persona, Mr. Midnight, the group find themselves in increasingly perilous situations. At the same time, Tyar begins to unravel a family secret that may just lead to the key that will not only save them, but their home as well. As the situation escalates, Tyar's four friends, Ling, Nat, Zoe and Ben also face their own personal demons. As Tyar's visions become more real, his friends are drawn into a cat and mouse game with a malevolent spirit.
title: Mr. Midnight: Beware the Monsters

overview: The Travelling Auctioneers sees Christina, JJ, Robin and Izzie split off into pairs and take their travelling auction house and workshop out on the road across the UK. Along the way, they'll unearth hidden gems and turn unwanted items into winning lots. Sifting through one family home at a time, the team will first need to identify the items with the biggest selling appeal. Christina and Izzie will then call on their auctioneer contacts and expertise, whilst JJ and Robin use their incredible craft and restoration skills to bring new life to neglected treasures – ready for a thrilling on-site auction at the end of each episode.
title: The Travelling Auctioneers

overview: A look inside two of Scotland's biggest families.
title: Scotland's Biggest Families

overview: Documentary telling the inside story of the revolution that transformed Wales from a team lower than Haiti in the world rankings to World Cup heroes.
title: Together Stronger

overview: Series showcases the biggest and best war machines on battlefields around the globe, traveling the world to see the elite technology from the land, sea and air and meet the brave soldiers who operate them every day.
title: Combat Countdown

overview: A special series to help guide you through everything you need to tackle as the days grow shorter and the temperatures drop.
title: Beechgrove Gardens in Winter

overview: Young Giovanna navigates her passage from childhood into adolescence as she experiences the different sides of Naples during the 1990s.
title: La vita bugiarda degli adulti

overview: Discover the inspired designs, architecture and stories behind some of the most beautiful waterfront cottages in America. With each unique home, experience a firsthand look at the joy that comes from living on the water.
title: Beach Cottage Chronicles

overview: Anfisa Chernykh and Anton Zaitsev set out on a journey across the country to find out where in Rus' to live well and happily. The hosts will explore the country and tell you amazing things about cities worth moving to. Where and for how much to rent a house? Where to get a job? Which restaurant to choose? No hackneyed advice from guidebooks, only answers to the most vital questions.
title: Пробный переезд

overview: The year was 1996, and the cola wars were raging. Despite Pepsi's celeb-soaked advertisements, Coke still held the bigger market share, so the second-place brand decided to roll out their biggest campaign ever: Called "Pepsi Stuff," it featured a soon-to-be infamous commercial implying that if you just bought enough of their products, you could use "Pepsi Points" to purchase sunglasses, leather jackets… and maybe a Harrier jet? Pepsi execs assumed the astronomical "price" of the military plane was set high enough to indicate it was a joke, but college student John Leonard saw it as a challenge, and decided to call their bluff. Enlisting the help (and funding) of mountaineering buddy Todd Hoffman, Leonard hashed out a plan to score the grandest prize of all – even if it never existed in the first place. Shot in a rollicking, irreverent style and soaked in the music and culture of the mid-'90s, Pepsi, Where's My Jet? sits down with Leonard, Hoffman, the commercial's creative team, and a truly unexpected cast of tangentially-involved public figures to tell the legendary tale of the kid who sued Pepsi for a fighter jet, and became the hero of a new generation.
title: Pepsi, Where's My Jet?

overview: Hanae, having just had her dreams of continuing karate dashed, meets Haruki, the writer of her pre-match song. This woman who has dedicated her life to karate, with no time for love, is now face-to-face with a man who fears he can't write good music because he's incapable of understanding the human heart. Now at a turning point in their lives, the pair begin a fake relationship in an attempt to understand true love. However, Hanae's enamored childhood friend Shingo gets involved, and a love triangle is formed. But she's got a secret, one that made her decide that this would be her final romance. Awkward yet candid, what will come of this heroine's first and last romantic adventure?! This humanistic rom-com with irritating sad love and growth.
title: Fight Song

overview: It is a military survival program in which reservists from the elite special forces form a team and fight for the honor of each unit.
title: Steel Troops

overview: Accidently swapped at birth, Pichaa and Pan go on to lead very different lives: Pichaa grows up with loving parents and a brother, Patin, while Pan is raised by a single parent in poverty. One fateful day, the two are returned to their biological families. Drama ensues when over a decade later, Pichaa is reunited with Patin, whom she once believed to be her brother. Things are further complicated when they fall for one another romantically.
title: Autumn in My Heart

overview: Two women's paths cross when they are both in the middle of their personal crossroads. Will they find love when they need it the least?
title: Lulu

overview: White women of LA are getting a serious confidence boost and a little dose of reality with the series premiere of "Bye Felicia!," premiering Tuesday, December 9 at 9PM. This 8-episode, hour long series follows Atlanta-based life coaches Deborah Hawkes and Missy Young as they set out to help white girls across the Los Angeles area. Each closed-ended episode aims to empower two different women who could use a dose of honesty in order to turn their lives around. Hoping to impart their unique experience and wisdom through motherly tough love, Deb and Missy teach these women to say hello to their better selves and goodbye to Felicia.
title: Bye Felicia!

overview: America by the Numbers with Maria Hinojosa is the first PBS documentary series to focus on the dramatic demographic shifts currently taking place in this country. As we explore underreported stories from every corner of the nation, we reveal the human face of the biggest population change in U.S. history. The new American mainstream—the growing number of Asians, Latinos, African Americans, mixed race, immigrants, women, youth, and LGBT—is influencing elections, culture, commerce, and every facet of contemporary life. We investigate these dynamic developments using infographics, statistical analysis, in-depth reporting, and compelling storytelling with anchor and executive producer Maria Hinojosa.
title: America by the Numbers

overview: 6 people live together in Xian's apartment, and romantic feelings begin to grow under the eaves...
title: My Roommate

overview: Based on a hit Australian television format, The Parent Test will explore the many distinctively different parenting styles. From helicopter to child-led parents, 12 families are put under the microscope in the ultimate parenting stress test and will share learnings about emotional hot-button topics that compare the multiple styles of parenting. The families are put through various situations to foster conversations about how each unit operates. Host Ali Wentworth and parenting expert Dr. Adolph Brown moderate these impassioned conversations amongst parents who may have conflicting opinions on how to raise their families, but they all share the common goal of raising happy, healthy children.
title: The Parent Test

overview: Fan-favorite cast members from the powerhouse Love & Hip Hop franchise reminisce and relive the biggest moments from the series by hitting rewind over the last 10 years. From breakups, shocking betrayals, and most buzzed about moments, viewers get to hear the juicy background story straight from the cast members through exclusive interviews and behind-the-scenes intel, while getting the latest updates on their successes today and surprising revelations of where life has taken our former cast members since we last saw them.
title: Love & Hip Hop: Where Are They Now?

overview: Black Widows: Kiss, Marry, Kill is a one-hour docuseries that chronicles the stories of deceitful women who marry men for the wrong reasons -- ending in murder.
title: Black Widows: Kiss, Marry, Kill

overview: The qualifiers for the 2022 FIFA World Cup are in full swing. Captain Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang prepares his golden generation Gabon team in a massive match against Mo Salah's Egypt. Injury gives Croatia captain and Ballon D'or winner Luka Modric the chance to reflect where it all began. Jamaica captain Andre Blake must unite a team of players, all with big ideas and bigger egos.
title: Captains

overview: The love between 13 famous couples will be put to the test in a competition full of challenges for the body and the mind, with which it will be evident how much trust exists between them. With ambitious bets, the participants will discover that betting on love is a great investment.
title: Inseparables: Amor al límite

overview: A dramatized biography of Anna German: a Polish singer, immensely popular in Poland and in the Soviet Union in the 1960s-1970s.
title: Anna German

overview: Series about eye-watering cases which come through the doors of British A&E departments.
title: Bizarre ER

overview: For food truck owners, Eddie Jackson's Rosehill Beer Garden is the hottest spot in Houston. Each weekend, three new food trucks compete for a chance to face off against the resident Rosehill food trucks to win a permanent spot. It takes fast ticket times, great personalities and showstopping food to impress Eddie, but the worst performing truck has to pull up stakes and head out of Rosehill for good.
title: Food Truck Face Off

overview: New Zealand's islands are home to an odd assortment of curious creatures that scoff at nature's norms. Birds can't fly, parrots play in snowy mountain meadows, and penguins roam the streets in these topsy-turvy habitats.
title: Wildest New Zealand

overview: Patrice L'Ecuyer est à la barre de Prière de ne pas envoyer de fleurs, une émission de variétés exceptionnelle. Chaque semaine, un artiste que vous aimez y perdra la vie, devant vos yeux, dans une fiction humoristique, par exemple en étant avalé par un monstre marin. Ensuite, nous célébrerons son passage sur terre à travers de vibrants, et parfois même de cinglants témoignages de ses proches, qui rappelleront de façon inusitée les moments de sa vie qui méritent d'être soulignés. Cette émission de variétés, un concept original, se traduira par une grande célébration de la vie et de la carrière d'artistes aimés du public québécois. Prière de ne pas envoyer de fleurs, mais peut-être d'en lancer... avec ou sans le pot!
title: Priere De Ne Pas Envoyer Des Fleurs

overview: Follows top UK trainer Andrew Balding and his stables at Kingsclere. Offering a behind-the-scenes look into the yard's fortunes (and misfortunes) as they search for the next equine superstar. Preparing runners for owners such as The Queen and the ruling family of Qatar, targeting world famous events such as the Breeders' Cup, Epsom Derby and Royal Ascot.
title: Horsepower

overview: The Good Ship Murder is set aboard a luxury cruise liner touring everyone's favorite Mediterranean holiday hotspots bubbling with intrigue, rivalries, glamour, money and class divides – but its new cabaret singer, ex detective Jack Grayling, soon discovers there are also more sinister elements below the surface. On a cruise out of Southampton, Jack meets newly promoted First Officer, Kate Woods. Fierce and ambitious, she's a woman in a man's world with plenty to prove. After a passenger is found murdered in their first port of call, Kate's dream of her own command is thrown into Jeopardy and Jack finds himself thrust back into his former life as a detective. What follows is a wave of murder mysteries – each set against the backdrop of a different stunning coastal destination where the ship has dropped anchor.
title: The Good Ship Murder

overview: This series follows some of the world's most extraordinary railway journeys from above and on the ground, taking the audience on an adventure of a lifetime.
title: World's Greatest Train Journeys from Above

overview: For the first time in its history, the Sydney Opera House has allowed cameras to go behind the scenes to reveal what it takes to run one of the world's busiest and most iconic performing arts centres.
title: Inside the Sydney Opera House

overview: The documentary series follows Bernhard Zünkeler over nine years as he set up his own art labs and artist collectives and established a global network of like-minded people between Los Angeles, Havana and Berlin.
title: Art is a State of Mind

overview: Till the World Ends is a story of two young men as they find themselves accidentally living together throughout the last 13 days of the world. Art a very attractive business student; unfortunately an accident caused him to lose his memories. Due to that, Art relies on Golf to help him navigate and prepare for the end of the world. Golf, a medical student, has a stressful history of family and relationship problems. Gus, his only brother also in jail, he has no one left. At the time Art has an accident, the government announces the evacuation of people to the bunker because the world will end soon. Golf, who was involved in the incident decided not to go to the bunker but to help Art instead. The rest of their lives outside were full of chaos. They both being chased by Long and Joke who had purpose to kill people as many as he can before the world ends. Golf has never felt what is a deep love from another person. He wanted nothing more, just to find love while he still has chance before he dies, Art wanted to go back to his hometown. Their relationship was improved and they seemed to know that they both are "in love". Golf and Art need to navigate their confusing feelings for each other. Because they both know exactly that they are going to die.
title: Till the World Ends

overview: Colonia Dignidad ('Dignity Colony') was a unique case in the world. It was a sect and an evil empire based upon sexual abuse and exploitation.
title: Los Sobrevivientes: Colonia Dignidad

overview: Riccardo Simonetti accompanies ten talents on their way to becoming Germany's next make-up star, rated by Armin Morbach and Loni Baur, among others.
title: Glow Up - Deutschlands nächster Make-up-Star

overview: Tug of Words, hosted by Samantha Harris. A wordplay game show from the team behind Who Wants to Be a Millionaire. Two teams compete to answer word-clue questions correctly and pull the flag on the "tug of war rope" to their side. In Round 1, each answer involves changing a single letter in the word that appears on the board.
title: Tug of Words

overview: In 1979, in Caguas, Puerto Rico, at the initiative of an ambitious and skilled businessman named Edgardo Díaz, a group was born that laid the foundations for the "boy bands" that still exist today. Creating never-before-seen rules and a work style that had never been implemented before, he developed a group that continues to be the benchmark for all other Hispanic youth bands.
title: Súbete a mi Moto

overview: Elena Blanco, veteran homicide inspector of the BAC (Case Analysis Brigade), is an intelligent woman obsessed with work, tormented by a dark event from her past. She tries to scare away her ghosts with alcohol, sex and music, while she searches for the culprit in the murder of Susana Macaya, a young gypsy girl who disappeared after her bachelorette party and with whom someone has performed a macabre ritual that reproduces the death of her sister seven years earlier. The great unknown is that Lara's murderer has been serving time since then, so either he has a copycat... or there is an innocent man in jail.
title: La Novia Gitana

overview: Have you ever wondered how to elegantly cut… a banana? Mind Your Manners follows world-renowned etiquette teacher Sara Jane Ho as she helps her students become their best selves and put others at ease, using the language of manners and etiquette. Get ready to laugh, cry, and learn a thing or two as Sara transforms her students' lives and helps them acquire the confidence to shine in any situation - starting with a sensible spot of afternoon tea. Pinkies in or out?
title: Mind Your Manners

overview: One day, Atsushi was suddenly told by his close friend Masa that Aota Niina has been abducted. Aota Niina is a female student from Seiryu Gakuen, and is someone whom Masa fell in love with at first sight. Atsushi went to Masa's apartment and found Niina being tied up. After hearing that the school's number one delinquent Ushijima would be arriving, Atsuhi quickly escaped the apartment with Niina. After that incident, Atsushi told Niina that the culprit was Ushijima, not Masa. However, due to trauma, Niina could not sleep at night and told Atsushi to take responsibility by becoming her bodyguard.
title: Itoshi no Nina

overview: From Greek Antiquity to the EU of 28, ten episodes to review the major stages of European history and celebrate the 60th anniversary of the Treaty of Rome. First part: the story begins with a founding Greek myth, that of the union between Zeus and the young princess Europe.
title: Notre Europe, quelle histoire !

overview: LazyTown is an Icelandic-American children's television program with a cast and crew from Iceland, the United Kingdom, and the United States. It was created by Magnús Scheving, a gymnastics champion and CEO of LazyTown Entertainment, who also stars in the show. Originally performed in English, the show has been dubbed into more than a dozen languages and aired in over 100 countries. A total of 52 episodes of LazyTown were produced from 2004 to 2007, for the show's first and second seasons. In the US, LazyTown originally aired on Nickelodeon and Nick Jr.; in 2011, PBS Kids Sprout gained the rights to air the series. Turner Broadcasting System Europe acquired the LazyTown Entertainment company in 2011 and commissioned a third season of the series to be delivered at the end of 2012 which premiered on April 6, 2013, in the UK. As of 2012, LazyTown airs on Turner Broadcasting's international preschool network, Cartoonito, and is distributed by Turner Broadcasting System Europe. LazyTown has generated several spin-off projects including stage productions and a TV program for younger children called LazyTown Extra.
title: LazyTown

overview: As we fly above the infamous battle sites of D-Day and Dunkirk, soar over hidden Nazi bunkers, and glide across lost battleships and sunken shipwrecks – this new series exposes secrets of World War Two - in a brand-new way.
title: World War II: Secrets from Above

overview: The 1619 Project seeks to reframe the country's history by placing the consequences of slavery and the contributions of Black Americans at the very center of the national narrative.
title: The 1619 Project

overview: The show "This is Miniatures" will bring together duets and trios that work in this genre. Within each episode, several participants will show numbers, and an auditorium of 100 people will put "likes" or "dislikes". The more votes "for" the comedians get, the greater their chances of winning the final prize - 200 thousand rubles. However, in the battle for victory, you need to defeat not only the declared rivals, but also the guest stars who will perform at the end of each issue.
title: Это миниатюры

overview: Based on NY Times Bestselling author James Patterson's #1 hero, Cross is a crime thriller that follows the investigations of brilliant forensic psychologist and DC Metro Detective Alex Cross. Together with his best friend and partner Detective John Sampson, Cross delves into the psyches of America's most insidious killers while fighting to protect his family from the dangers of the criminal world.
title: Cross

overview: Set against the backdrop of New York City's high-pressure nightlife scene, Black Rabbit centers on two brothers who are pushed to the brink by their duty to family and their pursuit of success. Jake Friedken is the charismatic owner of Black Rabbit, a restaurant and VIP lounge, poised to become the hottest spot in New York. But when his brother, Vince, returns to the business unexpectedly, trouble soon follows; opening the door to old traumas and new dangers that threaten to bring down everything they've built. Black Rabbit is a propulsive thrill ride and character examination about the way an unbreakable bond between two brothers can shatter their world and everything in its orbit.
title: Black Rabbit

overview: Thousands of great American cars are slowly rotting away in hidden places across the country. Most of these vehicles are long forgotten relics that are destined never to drive down another road. Derek Bieri of the popular Vice Grip Garage YouTube channel wants to change that. He has a deep seeded belief that all these vehicles should get a second chance. Follow Derek as he seeks out abandoned cars from America's past and gets them running and back on the road where they belong.
title: Roadworthy Rescues

overview: The Bends follows a seemingly perfect American family in Berlin whose secrets come to light when they hire a new nanny, unaware that she is trying to expose the parents' corrupt financial and familial ties.
title: The Bends

overview: With unpublished images, shows and rare interviews, the series bets on the irreverent way of the "síndico" of Brazilian music to narrate his own trajectory.
title: Vale Tudo com Tim Maia

overview: After being betrayed, Nawras and Ragheed embark on a perilous mission to obtain important papers that may grant them control over a global mafia and its trade.
title: Al Wasem

overview: Canada's Worst Driver is a Canadian television series on Discovery Channel, based on Britain's Worst Driver, and is part of the Worst Driver television franchise. It and sister series Canada's Worst Handyman are the two highest-rated programs on Discovery Channel. The series is produced by Proper Television, whose president, Guy O'Sullivan, was the director for the original Britain's Worst Driver series; as such, Canada's Worst Driver is considered to be the production company's flagship show. Unlike other Worst series around the world, the Canadian version emphasizes the learning process of the contestants and the science of driving, and as such is often more serious than the other Worst shows around the world, which are mainly played for laughs. It is the longest running of any Worst series to date. The series is also aired dubbed in French in Canada, as the Les zéros de conduite on Canal D.
title: Canada's Worst Driver

overview: Courtney Hansen leads an all-star team of the baddest custom car builders in the country, coming together each day to work on custom beauties to help make the lives of individuals who've faced tragedies and setbacks just a little bit better.
title: Ride of Your Life with Courtney Hansen

overview: A grandiose romantic experiment: the main bachelorette of the country is looking for a new love! No gigolos, hype guys, pumped eggplant jocks and mother's rappers - only real and sincere men in the fight for Nastya's heart.
title: Сердце Ивлеевой

overview: A modern take on the British royal drama, this steamy series offers a window into the lives of history's deadliest, sexiest and most iconic monarchs.
title: Blood, Sex & Royalty

overview: During the 90s, cocaine trafficking and control of Madrid's nightclubs was in the hands of a gang that monopolized hundreds of covers and television programs: Los Miami. His name caused the panic of those who heard him. "The Immortal" was the head of all of them.
title: El inmortal

overview: Waking up from a coma, an accomplished headhunter finds herself in an alternate reality where she has to revisit an excruciating childhood trauma.
title: Shards of Her

overview: A sudden car accident turned fan Song Yu Fei into the secret wife of entertainment industry actor Qin Jing Xiao. As they learn to get along, their first impression of each other changes, and soon sparks of love appear between them.
title: As Gentle as You

overview: During their studies, He Xiaozhan, Xiao Shangqi and Chen Fei'er were close friends. He Xiaozhan had loved Xiao Shangqi for eight years, but kept quiet about it because the young man was infatuated with Chen Fei'er. The incident on the eve of graduation destroyed the friendship between the inseparable trio. Faced with the double betrayal of love and friendship, He Xiaozhan moves from Shanghai to another city and becomes the host of a late-night radio show. Three years later, Xiao Shangqi arrives in the same city to become the manager of a four-star hotel that is on the verge of closing. Former friends reunite, and through misunderstandings, misunderstandings and difficulties, they finally get to know each other and come to love.
title: Almost Lover
